content.title: Verde Resources Appoints New Director Amid Leadership Changes
content.summary: An announcement from Verde Resources ( (VRDR) ) is now available. Verde Resources announced changes to its Board of Directors, with Eric Bava taking over from Chen Ching as Director. Bava, who has been the Chief Operating Officer since October 2023, has been instrumental in driving operational growth and strategic partnerships, enhancing the company’s position in sustainable building materials.
